basic_info.description: Elegant Pacific Heights residence in stately Tudor building with period flourishes in a tidy, well-managed HOA. This one bedroom, one bathroom condo features beautifully preserved hardwood floors, soaring ceilings, and oversized windows framing verdant outlooks onto flat, tree-lined Vallejo street. A generous dining room flows into the formal living room with built-in window seating and open kitchen with gas range and dishwasher. Tucked down the hall and separated from the public rooms is the bedroom wing with extensive closeting, and room for storage and hookups for a washer/dryer. Spacious, independent parking with private storage closets. The HOA has undertaken several significant permitted projects including a new roof in 2018 and sewer lateral in 2020. Explore local shopping and retail on Union, Polk, and Chestnut streets or adventure onward to Crissy Field to savor the view. Welcome home!
